observedAtLabel: When did you see the price (optional — otherwise now)
pricesHint: Price tags often show a regular price and a loyalty-card price side by side — enter both at once.
multibuyHint: E.g. "3 for 50" — enter the quantity and the total price.
promoValidityHint: Both dates are optional — "from" can't be in the future, "until" can.
